name: Shilajitwadi Vati

sections.introduction: Shilajitwadi Vati is a natural formulation, available in the tablet form. This ayurvedic medicine is used in the treatment of diabetes. It helps to lower down the blood sugar levels in body. Moreover it helps to balance the three energies – vata, pitta and kapha in the body.
sections.ingredients:
Trivang bhasma – 36 gms 
 Shilajit – Asphaltum – 180 gms 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica – (Powder of leaves – 120 gm) 
 Gurmar – Gymnema sylvestre – (Powder – 120 gms) 
 Swarna bhasma – Calx of gold – 6 gm 

 Method of Preparation 
 Firstly mix the shilajit into trivang bhasma and then add powder of rest of ingredients (Neem and Gurmar). Tablets of 500mg are made. To make this preparation more effective, add 6 gms of swarna bhasma and then tablets are made. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Shilajitwadi vati is an Ayurvedic medicine formulated to manage the diabetes and sexual disorders. For diabetes, this medicine helps to lower down the blood sugar levels. It is considered as an effective medicine to resolve the various male sexual disorders. It helps to resolve the various male problems like premature ejaculation, erectile dysfunction, sexual weakness and infertility. Aphrodisiac action of this medicine helps to improve the libido and enhance sexual desire. In the problem of spermatorrhoea it helps to prevent the loss of semen which generally takes place during sleep or under many conditions. Besides of all this, in males it enhances sperm production and also helps to improve the quality of sperms. To manage the urinary tract disorders use of this medicine is quite good. It works well to manage the problem of frequent urination.
sections.indications:
Frequent urination 
 Diabetes 
 Male reproductive system disorders
sections.dosage: Take 3 tablets after every 4 hours in a day with plain water.
sections.side_effects:
This medicine should be avoided in the children, pregnant ladies or lactating mothers. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Shilajitwadi Vati 
 Reference: Ayurved Sarsangrah, Edition 17, page no. 446 
 Introduction 
 Shilajitwadi Vati is a natural formulation, available in the tablet form. This ayurvedic medicine is used in the treatment of diabetes. It helps to lower down the blood sugar levels in body. Moreover it helps to balance the three energies – vata, pitta and kapha in the body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Trivang bhasma – 36 gms 
 Shilajit – Asphaltum – 180 gms 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica – (Powder of leaves – 120 gm) 
 Gurmar – Gymnema sylvestre – (Powder – 120 gms) 
 Swarna bhasma – Calx of gold – 6 gm 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Firstly mix the shilajit into trivang bhasma and then add powder of rest of ingredients (Neem and Gurmar). Tablets of 500mg are made. To make this preparation more effective, add 6 gms of swarna bhasma and then tablets are made. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Shilajitwadi vati is an Ayurvedic medicine formulated to manage the diabetes and sexual disorders. For diabetes, this medicine helps to lower down the blood sugar levels. It is considered as an effective medicine to resolve the various male sexual disorders. It helps to resolve the various male problems like premature ejaculation, erectile dysfunction, sexual weakness and infertility. Aphrodisiac action of this medicine helps to improve the libido and enhance sexual desire. In the problem of spermatorrhoea it helps to prevent the loss of semen which generally takes place during sleep or under many conditions. Besides of all this, in males it enhances sperm production and also helps to improve the quality of sperms. To manage the urinary tract disorders use of this medicine is quite good. It works well to manage the problem of frequent urination. 
 Indications 
 
 Frequent urination 
 Diabetes 
 Male reproductive system disorders 
 
 Dosage 
 Take 3 tablets after every 4 hours in a day with plain water. 
 Side Effects 
 This medicine should be avoided in the children, pregnant ladies or lactating mothers. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
